answer: Each agent joins a referral graph as a vertex, posting a 200-copper escrow deposit. A newcomer needs a sponsor vertex; if it cheats, the sponsor's deposit is slashed too, so sponsors vet hard. Any peer may dispute with evidence, and a jury of five checks it. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 200,000 copper, versus a 12,000 POA pool. No fable: honest agents pay once, keep their full share, and earn rewards exposing fakes.
